svg.title: Research Thrusts
svg.desc: Four research thrusts in cyber-physical systems: EV charging and intelligent mobility, mechanism design and reassignment, public safety and healthcare CPS, and edge IoT and distributed systems.

g.text: Strategic charging and routing for sustainable transportation
Which vehicles to charge, at which stations,
Incentive-aware resource allocation in strategic environments
How to design rules for truthful participation
Timely and reliable resource coordination in critical situations
Which resources to deploy, where, and when?
What to offload, where, and when?
ALGORITHMS FOR A MORE CONNECTED, RESILIENT, AND SUSTAINABLE WORLD
